title: Мясо в вегетарианских рулетиках  (Meat in the Vegetarian Rolls)

segments.t: While Max steps away from his station, pranksters Senya and Fedya sneak meat into the vegetarian rolls he prepared for Nastya's guest. When Max discovers what they did after the plate leaves the kitchen, Senya convinces him that the guest will never notice.
Это вы что вы тут делаете, а?
Как вы решили, вегетарианцы, нормальной едой не кормить?
Там сейчас вегетарианец мясо будет ездить.
Let's replay the exchange and look closely at each Russian phrase.
Это вы что вы тут делаете, а?
'What do you think you are doing here, huh?' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'this', while 'and' completes the thought.
Как вы решили, вегетарианцы, нормальной едой не кормить?
'How did you decide not to feed vegetarians normal food?' The plural past ending '-li' on the verb for 'decided' covers a group or the polite 'you'. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'With meat.' The meaning hinges on 'with' working together with 'meat' in spoken Russian.
'What happens when the chef is away?' Ainura brings out the contrast between 'where to' and 'of this' in a few short words.
'Oh. Go on.' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'and', while 'go' completes the thought. Ainura answers right away.
Там сейчас вегетарианец мясо будет ездить.
'Right now a vegetarian out there is about to eat meat.' In Russian, the idea of 'there' flows naturally into 'to drive' without extra filler words.
'What do you mean, meat?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'how' before landing on 'meat'.
'Why are you panicking?' In Russian, the idea of 'what' flows naturally into 'to panic' without extra filler words. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'He will not even notice anything.' The meaning hinges on 'even' working together with 'nothing' in spoken Russian.
'Really, it is true.' Ainura brings out the contrast between 'on' and 'very' in a few short words.
'You will even thank me later.' The meaning hinges on 'else' working together with 'will you say' in spoken Russian. Ainura answers right away.
'Agreed, vegetarians are total idiots too.' Notice how Russian expresses 'agree' and 'idiot' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Total idiots, right?' Chef Viktor brings out the contrast between 'idiot' and 'and' in a few short words. Let's hear the complete conversation once more.
Это вы что вы тут делаете, а?
Как вы решили, вегетарианцы, нормальной едой не кормить?
Там сейчас вегетарианец мясо будет ездить.
